name: oci-ssh
description: SSH into your Oracle Cloud instance from a throwaway container. The private key lives in a Docker volume, not on your laptop's disk.

scripts.create-vm: docker compose run --rm import-key && docker compose run --rm ssh
scripts.nuke: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker images --filter "reference=oci-ssh*" -q | xargs -r docker rmi -f || true && docker image prune -f || true && docker builder prune -f || true && docker volume rm oci-keys oci-known-hosts || true
